info.name: LegalTech Contract Parser API
info.description:
Complete API collection for LegalTech Automated Contract Parsing and Risk Extraction Engine.

Built by Member 1 (Backend/Django/PostgreSQL)

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/

All responses follow this format:
{
  success: true/false,
  message: string,
  status_code: number,
  data: object
}

request.description:
Check if the API is running correctly.
Returns counts of all documents, clauses and risk flags.

Get overall system statistics.
Includes document counts by status, risk counts by severity.

Upload a new PDF contract document.

Required: file (PDF, max 10MB)
Optional: contract_type, counterparty_name

Returns 201 with document details on success.

List all documents with pagination.

Optional filters:
- status: uploaded | processing | completed | failed
- contract_type: case-insensitive search
- search: searches file_name and counterparty_name
- ordering: uploaded_at | -uploaded_at | risk_score | -risk_score
- page: page number
- page_size: items per page (max 50)
Filter documents by status=uploaded
Search documents by file name or counterparty name

Get full detail of one document.
Includes all extracted clauses and risk flags nested inside.

Get quick summary of a document.
Includes risk counts by severity and clause counts by type.
Used by dashboard cards.

Update document processing status and metadata.

Allowed status values: uploaded | processing | completed | failed

All fields are optional (PATCH = partial update)

Save a single extracted clause for a document.

clause_type options:
confidentiality | termination | indemnification | governing_law |
limitation_of_liability | intellectual_property | dispute_resolution |
payment_terms | warranties | force_majeure | other

confidence_score: float between 0.0 and 1.0
page_number: integer >= 1

Save multiple clauses in one API call.
Send a JSON array of clause objects.
Returns count of saved clauses.

Get all extracted clauses for a document.
Optional filter: ?clause_type=confidentiality

body.raw:
{
    "risk_title": "Unlimited Liability Clause Found",
    "flagged_text": "The vendor shall be liable for unlimited damages arising from any breach of this agreement whatsoever.",
    "keyword_matched": "unlimited liability",
    "severity": "high",
    "page_number": 4,
    "explanation": "Unlimited liability clauses expose the company to uncapped financial risk and should always be reviewed by senior counsel."
}

request.description:
Save a single risk flag for a document.

severity options: low | medium | high
page_number: integer >= 1

keyword_matched and explanation are optional.

body.raw:
[
    {
        "risk_title": "Unlimited Liability Clause",
        "flagged_text": "The vendor shall be liable for unlimited damages arising from any breach.",
        "keyword_matched": "unlimited liability",
        "severity": "high",
        "page_number": 4,
        "explanation": "Unlimited liability exposes the company to uncapped financial risk."
    },
    {
        "risk_title": "Exclusive Rights Clause",
        "flagged_text": "The client retains exclusive rights to all work products and deliverables.",
        "keyword_matched": "exclusive",
        "severity": "medium",
        "page_number": 6,
        "explanation": "Exclusive rights clauses may restrict future business opportunities."
    }
]

request.description:
Save multiple risk flags in one call.
Send a JSON array of risk flag objects.

Get all risk flags for a document.
Optional filter: ?severity=high

Get all documents waiting for NLP processing.
Member 2 polls this endpoint to find work.
Returns documents with status=uploaded.

Fetch document details for NLP processing.
Returns file_path for Member 2 to read with PyMuPDF.
Also includes processing instructions.

Mark document as processing.
Member 2 calls this when NLP starts.

Submit complete NLP processing results.
This is the MAIN endpoint Member 2 uses.
Saves clauses + risks + metadata in ONE atomic call.
Returns 201 on full success, 207 on partial success.

Get all NLP results for a document.
Clauses grouped by type.
Risks grouped by severity.
Useful for Member 2 to verify saved data.
